header.text: The conjunctions after and before tell you when something happens.

header.text: The conjunctions as and while tell you that two things happen at the same time.

My brother likes to listen to music while he does homework.

header.text: The conjunction until tells you how long something takes or lasts.

contents.text: My mom told me to wait until she comes back.

header.text: The conjunctions because and since tell you why something happens or why something is true.
